rows.finding: Audit regression tests assert private helpers directly instead of the public behavior they purport to guard. test_audit_report calls _key_value_table, _flatten, and _format_number; test_audit_cli_examples calls _select_clock. If generate_report or CLI run stopped using those helpers while the helpers remained, these tests would stay green.
rows.consequence: The tests are brittle to the report/CLI refactors expected around publication and platform splitting, yet can be vacuous for the actual user-facing path. The HTML-escaping test is especially consequential because it would not detect removal of escaping from generated report pages.
rows.counterevidence: The helpers are currently called by the public implementations, the unit tests are fast and localize failures, and broader report/CLI integration tests exist. However, the manifest contains no public report-generation test carrying the malicious HTML values and no public CLI-run assertion that observes clock selection.
